rewrites.//: SPA fallback. Vercel resolves the filesystem BEFORE rewrites, so the prerendered dist/<route>/index.html files from scripts/prerender.mjs are served directly; this only catches routes that were not prerendered (/cart, /profile, an unknown product id). It targets app.html — the pristine empty shell — NOT index.html, which is now the prerendered homepage and would flash homepage markup on every fallback route.
